recipe.stopping_rule: fixed step count; no early stopping, no checkpoint selection
recipe.selection_rule: min mean writer CER delta at n=5 over the pre-registered LR grid
recipe.step_count_note: The protocol permitted choosing the step count on DEVELOPMENT alongside the LR. It was NOT searched: every cell ran at the registered maximum of 20 steps. This uses strictly LESS selection freedom than the protocol allowed, never more.
recipe.lr_grid_boundary_note: The selected rate 3e-02 is the HIGHEST in the pre-registered grid, so the optimum may lie beyond it. The grid is pre-registered and is NOT extended. Recorded as a limitation, not acted on.
